INSIDE LIGHT

Room to work.
All in one place.

From the first file to the next commit.
The essential tools are already here.

Open catalog

Modules

A project-shaped workspace

Add languages, run commands and templates. The core editor, Git and terminal work independently of language modules.

python, c/c++, lisp, web, docsOpen catalog

Editor

Keep code in focus

Smart indentation, auto-pairs, folding, bracket highlighting, undo and redo. Language rules come from the module.

editor

Navigation

Spend less time searching

File outlines, project search, go to definition and find usages. Completion and documentation use the project index and module data.

Ctrl + B / Ctrl + Space

Git and GitHub

Keep history close

Branches, diffs, commits and repository cloning in one workspace. Connect GitHub to choose your repositories inside Light.

git

Local snapshots

Return to working code

Save project states, inspect changes and restore files. Local history works even without Git.

local history

Terminal and runs

From code to results

A built-in terminal, module run commands and custom project scenarios. Output and compiler messages appear in Run and Problems.

Shift + F10

Linux through WSL

One workspace

Work in Linux from Windows: terminal, builds, runs and installation of tool groups defined by your modules.

Windows + WSL

Documents

See the result as you write

Markdown and reStructuredText with preview alongside your text. Scrolling stays in sync; headings, tables, links and code blocks stay readable.

preview

Themes

Your working colors

Dark and light themes, a custom palette, syntax and bracket colors. Your custom settings stay when you switch themes.

Dark / Light / Custom

Open source

A workspace you can change

Light is built with Rust and egui. Source is available under MIT / Apache-2.0; modules are defined as data, and the CLI works without a window.

Rust / egui / CLI
